title: Design a URL Shortener (like bit.ly)
description: Design a URL shortening service that generates short URLs, redirects users, and handles analytics.
requirements: Shorten a long URL to a short URL
Redirect short URL to original long URL
High availability and low latency redirects
hints: Think about the encoding strategy — how do you generate unique short codes?
Consider read vs write ratio — URL shorteners are heavily read-heavy
Where would you put a cache layer?
How do you handle hash collisions?
What database would you choose and why?
